entities.name: Van Riebeeck Arrives 1652
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: VOC commander Jan van Riebeeck establishes refreshment station 1652; Khoikhoi dispossession begins; slaves imported from East Africa, Madagascar, and Southeast Asia; Cape Town grows.
